links_touching_record.rationale: Implementation element FB2-SW-IMP-000001 is the code location in which the reference project's FB2-SW-DSN-000001 acquisition, PEC-validation and publication responsibilities are carried: the pinned source's LTC_Trigger sequencer, its LTC_StartVoltageMeasurement command selection, its LTC_CheckPec per-LTC integrity gate, its LTC_SaveRxToVoltageBuffer reassembly and the DMA-backed SPI transfer the design selects, which the source realises through SPI_TransmitReceiveDataDma and AFE_DmaCallback rather than through the symbols the design names. The link runs from the implementation to the design because that is the direction master prompt section 13 declares for implements (implementation element -> design/requirement).

The driver architecture is bound to one device in an explicit part-number constraint, in a DMA buffer size that follows from that device's frame, and in an implementation mapping whose every row is an LTC path.

FB2-SW-SWR-000001 is allocated to the reference project's FB2-SW-DSN-000001 as the software requirement whose implementation that design details. Direction is requirement -> design element, as master prompt section 13 declares for allocated_to.

FB2-SW-DSN-000004 refines FB2-SW-DSN-000001 in the sense master prompt section 13 gives refines: the source side is the lower-level, more specific element and the target side is its parent. DSN-000001 allocates the AFE measurement element to the LTC driver and states its interfaces and budgets at architecture level; DSN-000004 specifies the same element's internals - which source-level unit performs each part, what the CRC-15 and per-device validity contract is, how transmit_ongoing is shared across an interrupt and a task, and which timing macros the source imposes. Neither record contradicts the other and no content was moved between them; this link exists so that the trace from the architecture allocation to the detailed specification is navigable and so that a reader landing on DSN-000001 learns that a detailed design exists beneath it. Direction is detailed design -> architecture, the inverse of allocated_to.

The AFE design record's interfaces field is a signal table: it names cell_voltages as uint16_t[] in mV at 20 Hz and says nothing about who calls it, what the legal string range is or how a failure is reported. FB2-SW-IFS-000001 replaces that table with the six declared elements of the API, their real signatures, the assertion that bounds the string argument, the two-value return contract and the 1 ms period the calling task imposes. It refines FB2-SW-DSN-000001, the architecture record whose signal table it supersedes, and is at the same level as FB2-SW-DSN-000004, the detailed design record for the same element: it adds the interface contract that the detailed design record also does not carry.

integrity.anchor_registry_note: The corpus provenance gate verifies each anchor against the file that anchor names and stores no registry-level digest of its own. This digest is recorded so a signature also pins which anchor set was in force.
integrity.verbatim_block_note: The block in section 3 is the file's decoded text with any single trailing newline removed, which is what the markdown fences require. `record_sha256` above is over the raw file bytes and is the digest a signature refers to; this one is over the text as embedded, so a verifier can compare either.
